name: Trinity College Dublin
notes: Two published bands. Band B is 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each band and covers the majority of undergraduate and postgraduate courses; Band C is 7.0 with 6.5 in each band for selected courses. Results must be issued within two years of course start.

name: University College Dublin
notes: Standard undergraduate minimum is 6.5 overall with not less than 6.0 in any component; some courses ask for more. Postgraduate figures are set per programme and are not consolidated here.

name: University of Galway
notes: Baseline for Arts, Business, Law, Science and Engineering undergraduate programmes is 6.5 with no section below 6.0. Medicine asks for 6.5 in every component instead of the usual 6.0 floor. Postgraduate figures are set per programme and are not consolidated here.

name: University College Cork
notes: One floor of 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each band applies to both undergraduate and postgraduate programmes outside the College of Medicine and Health, which sets a higher figure.

name: TU Dublin
notes: The minimum standard is unusually flat: 6.0 overall with no component below 6.0 — there is no lower floor under the headline figure, unlike most universities where the component floor sits half a band under the overall score. Some programmes (e.g. Law with a Language, Strategic Management) ask for 6.5 instead.

name: Dublin City University (DCU)
notes: DCU requires IELTS 6.5 with no band less than 6.0 for both undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. Business School postgraduate courses require 6.5 with at least 6.5 in Writing.

name: University of Limerick
notes: General admission requires IELTS 6.5 with no band less than 6.0. Certain postgraduate programmes in Humanities and Education may require 7.0 overall.

name: Maynooth University
notes: Standard undergraduate entry requires IELTS 6.5 overall (minimum 6.0 in Writing). Postgraduate entry requires IELTS 6.5 overall with minimum 6.0 in each sub-test.

name: Munster Technological University
notes: Undergraduate degrees require IELTS 6.0 with no band lower than 5.5. Postgraduate programmes require IELTS 6.5 with no band lower than 6.0.

name: Atlantic Technological University
notes: ATU standard undergraduate requirements are IELTS 6.0 with no individual score below 5.5. Taught postgraduate requires 6.5 with no score below 6.0.

name: South East Technological University
notes: SETU requires IELTS 6.0 (no band below 5.5) for undergraduate degree programmes, and IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0) for postgraduate level 9 masters degrees.

name: Technological University of the Shannon
notes: TUS standard undergraduate baseline is IELTS 6.0 overall with no band below 5.5. Postgraduate master's programmes require 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0.

name: Dundalk Institute of Technology
notes: Undergraduate degrees require IELTS 6.0 overall. Postgraduate courses require IELTS 6.5 overall with no section below 6.0.

name: Dun Laoghaire Institute of Art, Design and Technology
notes: Undergraduate baseline is IELTS 6.0 with no band less than 5.5. Postgraduate programmes require IELTS 6.5 with no band less than 6.0.

name: Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland
notes: Medical, Pharmacy, and Physiotherapy degree programmes require a minimum IELTS score of 6.5 with at least 6.5 in all four components.

name: National College of Ireland
notes: Standard undergraduate entry requires IELTS 6.0 overall with no band lower than 5.5. Master's degrees require IELTS 6.5 with no band lower than 6.0.

name: Dublin Business School
notes: DBS undergraduate programmes require IELTS 6.0 (no component below 5.5). Postgraduate programmes require IELTS 6.5 (no component below 6.0).

name: Griffith College Ireland
notes: Undergraduate bachelor's degrees require IELTS 6.0 overall. Postgraduate master's programmes require IELTS 6.5 overall with no section under 6.0.

name: Mary Immaculate College
notes: MIC requires IELTS 6.5 overall with a minimum of 6.0 in each sub-test for all undergraduate arts and postgraduate degree admissions.

name: Shannon College of Hotel Management
notes: Undergraduate business in international hotel management requires IELTS 6.0 with minimum 5.5 in each skill. Postgraduate programmes require 6.5 with 6.0 each.
